equipment.rod.fiberglass.name: Fiberglass rod
equipment.rod.fiberglass.description: Every village angler's rod. It responds at the right pace for someone still learning.
equipment.rod.carbon.name: Carbon rod
equipment.rod.carbon.description: Heavier in the hand and calmer on the line: it softens the spike of a burst.
equipment.line.nylon.name: Nylon line
equipment.line.nylon.description: Cheap and honest. Holds fish up to 6 kg in shallow water.
equipment.line.braided.name: Braided line
equipment.line.braided.description: Holds twice what nylon does, reaches deeper and resists rubbing against rocks.
equipment.line.special_gift.name: Special Line
equipment.line.special_gift.description: A gift from an old friend. He said to use it only when you truly needed it.
equipment.reel.basic.name: Simple reel
equipment.reel.basic.description: Reels in without hurry and without surprises.
equipment.reel.geared.name: Geared reel
equipment.reel.geared.description: More torque and more speed: it tires the fish faster through how you fight.
character.spike_guide.name: Lab guide
dialogue.spike.guide.hello: Hi! This is the exploration lab. Everything here is temporary, but it works.
dialogue.spike.guide.fishing: The blue mark is the fishing spot. Before casting, check the gear warning.
dialogue.spike.guide.portal: The green one takes you to the other side of the map. In the final game, those are the voyages.
character.player.name: You
character.friend.name: Friend
character.friend_family.name: Friend's wife
character.villager.name: Village fisher
character.organizer.name: Tournament organizer
character.alien_a.name: Stranger A
character.alien_b.name: Stranger B
dialogue.friend.first: Well, look who finally left the house!
dialogue.friend.teach: It's simple: cast and wait. When a fish bites, you'll feel it.
dialogue.friend.teach_more: Then reel in, nice and easy. If it makes a run, hold on and let it take a little line.
dialogue.friend.again: Still here? The fish are at the pier, not in my yard.
dialogue.friend.after_catch: Look at that! You never forget your first one.
dialogue.friend.festival_wait: Told everyone yet? The neighbor, the baker and the old man at the pier.
dialogue.friend.spread: Do me a favor: tell the neighbor, the baker and the old man at the pier. No party without them.
dialogue.friend.boss: That thing by the pier... You remember what I gave you.
dialogue.friend.gift: Before the party's over... I've got something for you.
dialogue.friend.gift_rule: Keep it safe. Only use it if you really need to.
dialogue.friend.gift_why_answer: Because you've got a knack for it.
dialogue.friend.gift_thanks_answer: Don't thank me. Just don't make me regret it.
dialogue.villager.calm: Good day for fishing. The sea is calm today.
dialogue.villager.alarm: Hey! Have you seen the pier?
dialogue.villager.alarm_nobody: Everyone has tried to catch the thing. Nobody can hold it.
dialogue.villager.boss: That thing is still out there, by the pier. A regular line won't hold it.
dialogue.villager.after_boss: It's over. But the village won't be the same.
dialogue.family.letters: We found these among his things. Letters, parcels... They kept coming for months.
dialogue.family.letters_kept: He told them he was done fishing. They kept sending them anyway.
dialogue.family.letters_ask: We can't keep these here. Please take them... and make it stop.
dialogue.family.talk: The house is getting back on its feet. Thank you for helping.
dialogue.family.search: Have you seen him? He was home when everything came down.
dialogue.organizer.busy: Not now, I'm running the tournament. Win it and talk to me at the dinner.
dialogue.organizer.rounds: Three rounds. The fishing spots open one at a time. Good luck.
dialogue.organizer.dinner: Well, if it isn't the champion!
dialogue.player.dinner_letters: Letters keep coming for my friend. He died.
dialogue.aliens.sorry: Sorry about the way we brought you here.
dialogue.aliens.searching: We've been looking for fishers. Very good ones.
dialogue.aliens.confession: The giant fish in your village... we were the ones who brought it there.
dialogue.aliens.choice_killed: My friend died because of that.
dialogue.aliens.ask: We need someone like you. Come with us.
dialogue.aliens.choice_accept: I'll go. But that doesn't change what you did.
story.card.friend: An old friend insists it's time you learned to fish.
story.card.months: Months go by. Your friend teaches, and the village becomes home.
story.card.festival: A festival night in the village.
story.card.boss_caught: After a long, destructive fight, the giant fish finally breaks the surface.
story.card.damage: Surveying the damage, you learn that your friend's house was one of the first to be hit.
story.card.funeral: After the funeral, you offer to help his family rebuild.
story.card.invitation: At home, among the letters, you find an invitation to a fishing tournament. The next day, you follow the address.
story.card.venue: The address leads to a crowded hall. Near the entrance, two strange figures watch. Someone sees your invitation and signs you up on the spot.
story.card.final: In the final, another colossal creature, of the same kind that destroyed the village. The Special Line holds.
story.card.knocked_out: Late at night, on the way to the car, everything goes dark.
story.card.wake_up: You wake up on a ship. The two strangers from the tournament are there, with others you have never seen. They talk in an unknown language.
story.card.ship: You accept. That does not mean friendship, or forgiveness. Not yet. The ship departs.
objective.meet_friend: Talk to your friend, near his house.
objective.pier: Catch a fish at the pier.
objective.tell_friend: Show the fish to your friend.
objective.boss: Face the giant fish at the pier. Maybe it is time for the Special Line.
objective.go_tournament: Follow the road to the invitation's address.
objective.prologue_done: End of the prologue. The journey continues in the next phase.

character.survivor_a.name: Survivor A
character.survivor_b.name: Survivor B
dialogue.survivors.world_a: My world had no seas. No lakes, no rivers.
dialogue.aliens.mourn: We know. We are sorry for his death.
dialogue.friend.first_b: Grab a rod. Today you learn to fish.
dialogue.friend.teach_end: Fight it at the wrong moment and the line snaps. Go on, the pier is right there.
dialogue.friend.invite: There's a party in the village tonight. You're coming, right?
dialogue.friend.invite_yes_answer: That's the spirit. See you there.
dialogue.friend.invite_maybe_answer: Sure you do. See you there.
dialogue.friend.gift_line: This line. It's rare. Very rare.
dialogue.friend.gift_why_answer_b: And because I won't be using it anymore.
dialogue.villager.alarm_fish: A huge fish showed up. It wrecked half of it!
dialogue.family.letters_thanks: Thank you for staying to help with the house.
dialogue.family.letters_mark: All with the same mark as the line he gave you.
dialogue.organizer.dinner_ask: Now then. What did you need?
dialogue.aliens.alone: We needed to talk to you alone. We are not from Earth.
dialogue.aliens.recognized: We recognized your invitation at the tournament. And the line.
dialogue.aliens.confession_lead: There's something you need to know.
dialogue.aliens.confession_why: To find someone who could catch it.
dialogue.aliens.mourn_silent: ...We know what it cost. We are sorry.
dialogue.survivors.world_a_came: One day, creatures like that one started to appear.
dialogue.survivors.coming: And whoever sends them is on the move. Earth is in the way.
dialogue.neighbor.first: Morning. The old man down the way asked about you earlier.
dialogue.neighbor.after: He likes you. And he doesn't like many people.
dialogue.neighbor.festival: A party tonight? Then there'll be grilled fish until nobody can eat more. I'll bring the big pot.
dialogue.neighbor.boss: Nobody has slept right since that thing showed up at the pier.
dialogue.kid.first: The village has three piers. The big one in the middle is the best, my dad says.
dialogue.kid.after: You caught one! Will you teach me later?
dialogue.net_mender.first: Torn net again. Half of fishing is mending what tore.
dialogue.net_mender.boss: I'm not mending anything while that thing is out there.
dialogue.net_mender.after_boss: It's over. Now there are torn nets for a whole month.
dialogue.fisher_old.first: Cast and wait. The sea decides when, not you.
dialogue.fisher_old.caught: You got one. Go show the old man, he will want to see it.
dialogue.fisher_old.festival: A party, huh? Tell the old man I'll save a spot by the bonfire.
dialogue.fisher_old.boss: I saw it up close. Snapped the pier plank like a twig.
dialogue.east_fisher.first: You catch less on this side, but it is quieter. Each to their own pier.
dialogue.east_fisher.road: The road leaves up north. That is how you get to the city.

character.kid.name: Village kid

character.fisher_old.name: Old fisher
character.east_fisher.name: East pier fisher
item.crates: Crates stacked for too long. A spare line at the bottom.
item.crates_after: Just old wood and dust now.
item.net_rack: A braided line coiled behind the nets. Nobody has claimed it.
item.net_rack_after: The nets are still there, drying.
item.bench: The wood is worn in the middle, from so many people sitting.
item.nets: Nets spread to dry. Smell of sea air and salt.
item.rowboat: The hull has been patched so many times it became another boat.
item.rowboat_east: Turned upside down, waiting for the tide.
item.trap: Empty lobster trap. The bait is gone, and so is the lobster.
item.rope: Rope coiled with care. Someone here takes pride in the work.
item.bucket: A bucket with two fingers of water and no fish.
dialogue.fishmonger.empty: Bring me fish and I will buy it. The queue never stops and I have nothing to sell.
dialogue.fishmonger.buy: Put it on the stall and I will weigh it. The money buys better gear.
dialogue.client_1.line: I have been in this queue since morning. The fishmonger has nothing today.
dialogue.client_2.line: If you fish, I will buy. Dinner does not solve itself.
dialogue.client_3.line: I am in no hurry. I am hungry, but in no hurry.
dialogue.baker.talk: Bread comes out before dawn. Whoever fishes early gets it warm.
dialogue.baker.festival: A party tonight? Then I'll bake twice the bread. Thanks for telling me.
dialogue.boat_builder.talk: I have patched hulls my whole life. A good boat is one patched with care.
dialogue.gatekeeper.talk: Come in, come in. The organiser is at the back, by the hall.
dialogue.rival.before: Here to compete? Half these people came just to watch.
dialogue.rival.after: Three rounds. Whoever reaches the last one has already won something.
dialogue.spectator_1.talk: The stalls sell real gear. If you have coin, it is worth it.
dialogue.spectator_2.talk: What pulls on the line here is no pier fish. It is something else.
dialogue.stand_rod.talk: Carbon rod. It bends and does not break, which is all you ask of it.
dialogue.stand_line.talk: Braided line. Holds more than nylon, and costs accordingly.
dialogue.stand_reel.talk: Geared reel. Reels faster and tires the arm less.
rubble.house: The wall fell inward. Between the planks, a hand.
rubble.boat: The boat flipped and ended up far from the water.
rubble.nets: The nets were dragged away along with the rack.
rubble.pier: Half the planks are gone. The rest point upward.
venue.poster: Tournament poster: three rounds, one at a time.
dialogue.organizer.enroll: You are from the invitation. There, you are entered. Now win, and we talk at dinner.

equipment.rod.old.name: Friend's old rod
equipment.rod.old.description: It has seen better days. It still fishes — for now.
equipment.line.old.name: Old line
equipment.line.old.description: The line that came with the friend's rod, faded by the sun.
equipment.reel.worn.name: Worn reel
equipment.reel.worn.description: Creaks with every turn. It came with the old rod.
equipment.rod.carved.name: Wooden rod
equipment.rod.carved.description: Handmade by the carpenter, with village wood and beach stones in the handle.
equipment.reel.old.name: Old pier man's reel
equipment.reel.old.description: Kept for years. Sturdy, but not new.
dialogue.friend.old_rod: Here, take my old rod. It's seen better days, but it fishes.
dialogue.friend.broken: And the rod? Broke? It was begging for a rest.
dialogue.friend.carpenter: Leave it to me. Talk to the carpenter, over by the boats. He'll make you a new rod.
dialogue.friend.carpenter_wait: The carpenter is over by the boats, on the east side. Go talk to him.
dialogue.friend.rod_ready: Let me see... Light, steady. The man knows what he does.
dialogue.friend.reel: Now you need a reel. Talk to the old man at the big pier, he's got one put away.
dialogue.friend.reel_wait: The old man at the big pier has a reel put away. Go talk to him.
dialogue.friend.reel_seen: The old man's reel! He doesn't give that to just anyone.
dialogue.friend.line: Then all that's left is the line. Here: it's simple, but it holds pier fish.
dialogue.friend.meet_people: Now go meet the village folks. People here help newcomers.
dialogue.friend.search: And search around. Lots of things get lost in the village, and whatever you find is yours.
dialogue.friend.sell: Then catch some fish and sell them to the fishmonger. You'll need the money.
dialogue.friend.sell_wait: Catch some fish and take them to the fishmonger. She pays well.
dialogue.boat_builder.ask: The old man sent you? I'll make a rod. Wood is wood, hull or handle.
dialogue.boat_builder.ask_b: But I need material: four pieces of good wood and three beach stones, for the weight.
dialogue.boat_builder.wait: Four pieces of wood and three beach stones. There's loose wood all over the village.
dialogue.boat_builder.deliver: That will do. Give me a minute.
dialogue.boat_builder.deliver_b: Done: a wooden rod, handmade. Reel and line aren't my trade.
dialogue.fisher_old.reel_ask: A reel? I've got an old one, put away a long time.
dialogue.fisher_old.reel_ask_b: It's yours. But do me a favor: gather five starfish on the beach for me.
dialogue.fisher_old.reel_wait: Five starfish. On the sand, near the water.
dialogue.fisher_old.reel_deliver_b: Here, the reel. Take care of it.
objective.carpenter: Wood and stones for the carpenter
objective.starfish: Starfish for the old pier man
collect.wood: You pick up a piece of wood.
collect.stone: You pick up a smooth beach stone.
